instructions:
1. Place your feet on a chair and your hands on the floor close together, forming a diamond shape with thumbs and index fingers.
2. Brace your core so your body makes a straight line from head to heels.
3. Lower your chest toward your hands by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
4. Push through your hands to straighten your arms.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stop your hips from sagging.
2. Keep your elbows tucked close to your body to load the triceps.
3. Use a stable chair so it cannot slip.
4. Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor close together in a diamond shape, hips raised toward the ceiling.
2. Set your body in an inverted V with straight legs and torso.
3. Lower your head toward your hands by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
4. Push through your hands to straighten your arms.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips high and legs straight to hold the pike position.
2. Keep your elbows tucked to load the triceps and front shoulders.
3. Move under control on the way down.
4. Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Kneel with your knees on a low step and place your hands on the floor shoulder-width apart.
2. Set your body in a straight line from head to knees.
3. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows to about 45 degrees from your body.
4. Push through your hands to straighten your arms.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees, not flared wide.
2. Move under control through the full range.
3. Keep your hips in line with your shoulders and knees.
4. Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked under the footpads.
2. Hold your torso parallel to the floor, raised off the bench.
3. Place your hands behind your head with your elbows out to the sides.
4. Curl your upper body toward your knees without pulling on your neck.
5. Lower back to the parallel position under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso off the bench so the abs stay loaded.
2. Do not yank on your neck; let the abs do the work.
3. Use a stable bench so it cannot move.
4. Exhale as you curl up and inhale as you lower.
